description: Predeclared matched RFC extension comparisons; synthetic data only; fixed budget, all conditions and failures retained.
rng: Initial tree jitter retains original fixture seeds. New layouts use an independent seeded LCG (seed xor 0x00c0ffee) solely for exact coincidences.
rigidity: Queued TG rigidity is primed on an empty graph before registering forces. Every measured integration uses the declared rigidity; no graph warm-up.

definitions.motion: Actual movements over every integration, including all ten within each batch. Tail is the last 100 integrations; zero motion alone is not convergence.
definitions.largeSteps: Integrations in which any movable node travels >29.9 units (Euclidean).
definitions.clippedSteps: Integrations in which any movable node moves >=30-1e-9 along either axis; counted independently of Euclidean large steps.
definitions.trace: Batch 1 and every tenth batch: max/RMS cover that ten-integration batch, not the entire interval between trace records. Cumulative totals cover every integration.
definitions.force: At final coordinates, zero momentum, local damping disabled, global damper zero: measure the first ordinary TG+RFC force evaluation on movable nodes. RMS vector magnitude divided by global rigidity. Probe does not move nodes and is excluded from motion totals; this is a net force-balance diagnostic, not an energy or stability proof.
definitions.treeErrors: Physical lengths and merged angular gaps on the complete original selected-tree union, including zero-weight branches. Same geometry observables in every condition; individual tree errors and shared-root length lower bounds retained.
definitions.weightedErrors: q-weighted RMS on the original tree-edge union, alongside common unweighted errors. Zero contributions excluded from its denominator; never used alone to claim improvement.
definitions.clusterErrors: All internal semantic links vs their integer spring-length targets; all-pairs deformation vs analytic unjittered square/ring geometry, independent of activation/projection. Deformation combines per-community pair RMS values with equal community weight.
definitions.drawing: Strict straight-segment crossings between nonincident semantic edges and movable-node pairs closer than 30. Physical centers only, not curved browser paths or measured labels; these are limited geometry proxies, not human readability.
definitions.overlap: Intersection area of convex physical member-center hulls. Shared-membership overlap is expected; no exclusion constraint or displayed rounded hull is measured.

weights.transition: neutral -> exact zero -> epsilon. Both transitions explicitly wake TG. Sham profile retains neutral weights with identical wakes. Baseline equality is audited within wake schedules.
